recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed; any future editorial cleanup to the extension short text should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-40719 was an Applied/Persuasive Vocabulary change request asking to replace the ambiguous valueset-caseSensitive description with text saying the extension asserts whether the code is case sensitive, that the assertion SHALL follow the code system definition, and that the extension SHALL NOT be used when the expansion-generating server does not know the code system's case sensitivity rules.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to HL7/fhir-extensions#120. In the FHIR Extension Pack checkout, commit d97f79ca36608f23471b0b224b75bfc9e892015d updated input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-caseSensitive.xml so the description and definition now carry the approved assertion and SHALL language.
additional_context: Current core search finds valueset-caseSensitive only in source/oids.ini and historical release snapshots under tools/history, with no active source/fhir.ini build entry for the extension definition. Vocabulary meeting minutes for 2024-02-26 list FHIR-40719 as discussed and resolved, and no conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source was changed because the maintained source for this extension is in the FHIR Extension Pack and already contains the approved clarification.
